newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Two accused sorcerers burned to death in new Congo.
newsitem.headline: Two accused sorcerers burned to death in new Congo.

text.p: A married couple accused of being sorcerers were burned to death by an angry mob that included their own children, Congo television said on Thursday.
Maurice Bombango and his wife, from the capital Kinshasa, were accused of sorcery after the death of a family member on Tuesday.
"Even their own children sided with the mob," state television said. The couple were killed on Wednesday.
Since President Laurent Kabila ousted Mobutu Sese Seko in the former Zaire last month, people have increasingly taken the law into their own hands.
Many house-breakers caught red-handed have been lynched or burned to death by mobs.
The governor of the teeming capital said authorities would punish anyone who meted out "private justice".
